newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka plantations stock up on growth prospects.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka plantations stock up on growth prospects.

text.p: Prospects of good growth pushed up Sri Lankan plantation shares in early Monday trading, brokers said.

Kotagala Plantations rose 13.51 percent or five rupees to 42 and Kelani Valley was up 7.04 percent or 2.5 rupees to 38. Kegalle Plantations gained 6.85 percent or 2.5 rupees to 39 while Horana Plantations rose 4.23 percent or 1.5 rupees to 37.
"Plantations are seen doing well in 1997 due to good demand for Sri Lanka tea, mainly from the CIS (Commonwealth of Independent States)," a broker said.
